title: How We Handle It
description: HIPAA-compliant handling, the same care for every item, 24/7 including holidays, and the owner on the phone. How Premier Courier handles every run.
heading: Handled right, the first time.
lead: Deliveries that arrive when promised, in the condition they left.

points.title: HIPAA-compliant handling
points.body: Our drivers handle every item in a HIPAA-compliant manner.

points.title: The same care for every item
points.body: We treat every item with the utmost care, no matter its value.

points.title: Any hour, including holidays
points.body: Business doesn't stop at 5 p.m., on weekends, or on holidays. Neither do we.

points.title: Drivers your staff know by name
points.body: Friendly, meticulous drivers your staff will know by name.

owner.heading: One phone number, one person, any hour.
owner.body: The owner answers the phone directly — there is no answering service.

closing.heading: Scheduled routes that run without reminders.
